first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: teal stadium seating
entities.identification: Large sections of teal seats arranged in stepped tiers, with gray stairs, passageways, and light-colored railings between sections.

entities.name: stadium roof and trusses
entities.identification: A large-span gray canopy above the stands, with repeated trusses and some diagonal braces visible on the inside.

entities.name: pink-purple illuminated racing gate set
entities.identification: A set of pink-purple illuminated frame-shaped structures beside the field; the main discernible portion in this clip is near the lower part of Object M.

entities.name: green stadium turf
entities.identification: A broad, approximately flat green turf area in the stadium, with alternating wide dark and light stripes.

entities.name: gray sideline passageway
entities.identification: A long, narrow gray surface extending between the turf and the front edge of the seating.

entities.name: Object L
entities.identification: A white pentagonal thick-framed racing gate on the turf, with a hollow opening, pink feet, and a pink-purple illuminated inner edge.

entities.name: Object M
entities.identification: A tower-shaped racing apparatus beside the field, with cyan-blue illuminated posts, an opening between the posts, a relatively wide white top, and a pink-purple border around the top.

entities.name: Object N
entities.identification: A yellow structure in the image-left foreground, partially overlapping a wide pink-white illuminated frame structure.

entities.name: stadium floodlight strip
entities.identification: Rows of bright white light points and some intense light clusters near the roof.

entities.name: teal low sideline wall
entities.identification: A teal opaque low wall extending along the front edge of the seating, adjacent to the gray sideline passageway.
